text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"While putting together a training plan 
for our next race..."
choice_data_list: Huh, what are you doing up at this hour?
Huh, what are you doing up at this hour?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, you're the one talking about 
"this time of night"? You planning on 
pulling an all-nighter like this~?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
choice_data_list: Why would you... No, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Tasty, right? Tomatoes have this... uh, 
whatever-it's-called component that's 
supposed to help with fatigue!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, combined with the sweet-and-sour 
taste, it feels as if my vision is 
completely clearing up.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...I've been running race after race 
lately, right? Even I'm starting to feel 
the strain."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: So that made me think, maybe you too...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, chasing your dream is my wish too. 
But—it defeats the purpose if you 
collapse.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
We stop and tie our shoelaces together. 
Isn't that the kind of thing we need for 
our three-legged race?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It's pathetic that I had to be 
lectured by her instead. As her Trainer, 
her fatigue is my responsibility. I ought 
to review her upcoming race schedule..."
